title: data-agent-traces: code for "Data Agents Often Name Missing Data and Recover Cheaply; Harnesses Distort the Record"
description: Trace parsers for DABstep and DataAgentBench, an exact pre-execution checker for column, key and file names in agent-written Python, and the scripts of every experiment in the preprint. The repository contains no benchmark data; the scripts download each dataset at a pinned commit.
